articles.title: Ukraine bomber drones drop ground robots behind Russian lines to kill or injure 3,000 enemy troops in groundbreaking 'safari' mission.
articles.summary: Ukraine has deployed bomber drones to drop ground robots behind Russian frontlines in a groundbreaking 'safari' mission, reportedly targeting thousands of enemy troops. This innovative tactic marks a significant evolution in drone warfare, demonstrating advanced methods for bypassing defenses and engaging targets remotely. It underscores the increasing role of autonomous systems and strategic innovation in modern military operations.
